s_vs_s_plus_1_timing_asymmetry.empirical_discovery: Scanning signal-day S first-board names only captures actions with ex-date <= S. It misses all actions whose ex-date is S+1, which are precisely the ones that dictate target label Y.
s_vs_s_plus_1_timing_asymmetry.scientific_boundary: The 32 candidate ledger is strictly an interface-visible clue subset, NOT an exhaustive action database. Unmarked records (35,260) cannot be inferred as action-free. Repairing 3 or 32 cases does NOT mean all 28,503 records are fixed.

math_formulation.target_day_p_ref: P_ref = (P_close_prev - D + P_rights * S_rights) / (1 + S_bonus + S_rights)
math_formulation.historical_feature_adj_factor: AdjFactor(t | S) = prod_{tau in (t, S]} (P_ref(tau) / P_close(tau - 1))
math_formulation.causal_discipline: Strictly no adjustment factors from tau > S. Lookahead bias strictly prohibited.
